thread:
alex_support: Hey team -- Orca Analytics reported an end-of-cycle mismatch. Dashboard shows 1,206,412 tokens for Mar cycle, invoice INV-2026-0782 charged 1,812,978 tokens and auto-upgraded them to Pro tier which triggered overage. Customer is unhappy. Can finance/eng triage? :grimacing:

jessica_billing: Can you paste the customer_id + invoice id here? Also any screenshots of the dashboard vs invoice line items would help.

alex_support: customer_id: cust_ora_94, invoice: INV-2026-0782. Screenshot link: https://redwood-internal.s3/secure/orca/invoice-INV-2026-0782.png (private). Quick diff I copied from billing export: 
```
invoice_line_items: [{"service":"hosted-api","tokens":1206412},{"service":"dedicated-batch","tokens":692566}]
dashboard_total_tokens: 1206412
```
So invoice includes a dedicated-batch line we don't display in the customer facing dashboard.

mira_cs: Orca says they only used hosted endpoints. They pinged saying they didn't spin any dedicated jobs. They attached sample request IDs that map to hosted-api only.

samir_eng: Noted. Two immediate hypotheses: 1) usage-aggregator ETL double-counted entries stamped near cycle boundary (retry + window overlap), 2) dedupe key for batch jobs was null so some hosted events were attributed to dedicated-batch line. I'll run queries.

ashley_finance: Pls confirm whether we should put a temporary credit on that invoice while you root-cause. We want to avoid chargeback escalation.

alex_support: Please refund/credit the overage for now if it looks plausibly an internal issue. Customer is escalating.

messy-billing-bot: Automated alert: usage-aggregator job retried at 2026-03-01T00:01:12Z with status code 500 -> retry queued. Job run ids: run_20260301_0000 and run_20260301_0001.

samir_eng: Running SQL to look for duplicated events across runs. Query: 
```
SELECT event_id, count(*) as cnt, array_agg(job_run_id) as runs
FROM billing_events
WHERE customer_id='cust_ora_94' AND ts >= '2026-02-28T23:50:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-01T00:10:00Z'
GROUP BY event_id
HAVING count(*) > 1;
```

samir_eng: Results: 1,234 duplicated event_ids (mostly short-lived system tokens and some user tokens). Many of those duplicates have identical token counts and were attributed once to hosted-api and once to dedicated-batch due to missing "service_type" on retry.

jessica_billing: That explains the extra ~692k tokens. Can you show example rows for event_id=evt_7f9a3?

samir_eng: Example rows (redacted):
```
{event_id: "evt_7f9a3", customer_id: "cust_ora_94", tokens: 256, service_type: "hosted-api", job_run_id: "run_20260301_0000"}
{event_id: "evt_7f9a3", customer_id: "cust_ora_94", tokens: 256, service_type: null, job_run_id: "run_20260301_0001"}
```

ops_oncall: The retried run lost a service_type tag because the worker that replays the events reads from SQS and reconstructs metadata; if a partial payload came through, default is null which we map to dedicated-batch for historical reasons. That's a config bug.

ashley_finance: Thanks. From finance side: please provide an estimated corrected invoice and the delta so we can issue a credit. Also request that CS don't promise timeline to customer beyond "we're investigating and will follow up within 24h".

samir_eng: Planning fix: 1) Backfill: dedupe by event_id for the affected window and recalculate invoice lines, 2) Patch worker to preserve service_type on retries and add stronger validation; PR incoming. I can run a back-of-envelope reconciliation now.

samir_eng: Recalc numbers: remove duplicate rows -> invoice tokens drop by 692,566 -> corrected total = 1,120,412 (not 1,206,412? wait re-checking). Actually dashboard_total 1,206,412 seems to include some system tokens already; corrected invoice should be 1,206,412 matching dashboard after backfill. The 1,812,978 was inflated by duplicate attribution.

jessica_billing: Good. Ashley: can we auto-apply credit of (charged - dashboard) = 606,566 tokens worth of currency?

ashley_finance: Approve provisional credit of full delta pending root cause verification. Issue credit memo CM-2026-154. Finance will hold final adjustment until backfill job completes.

mira_cs: I'll message the customer with the short note: "We're investigating a billing discrepancy, provisional credit applied, we'll follow up with final reconciliation within 48 hours."

alex_support: Action items: samir -> backfill + patch worker (ETA 12h), ops_oncall -> review SQS replay validation (ETA 6h), ashley/jessica -> apply provisional credit and hold, mira -> customer comms. I'll keep the thread updated. :white_check_mark:

ops_oncall: Filed infra ticket INFRA-4372 to add schema validation to replay worker.

samir_eng: PR opened: github.com/redwood/ingest/commit/9b2f... will run backfill as job backfill-usage-20260301. I'll post logs when done.

alex_support: Thanks all. Marking as high priority. We'll reconvene after backfill completes. :eyes:
